paper_concerns: Eligibility: reactions at 100-170 °C ('photothermal'); at 170 °C with 1 equiv FeCl2 thermal alone gives 88%. Visible light is a co-stimulus rather than the sole driver; benchmark should flag photothermal.
Solvent, light source details (LED type, wavelength, intensity), Mn of PBzMA and most times are not in the main text (SI only).
'ppm' catalyst level is described in prose but only '0.05 equiv' with respect to end-group is printed; no ppm number.

Unrecorded text results: 120 °C 71% (¶4); 1 equiv on/off 31% after dark period (¶4); thermal yield eliminated (implicitly 0%) at 150/120/100 °C with 0.05 equiv FeCl2 (¶6) and no monomer at 150/120 °C thermal with FeCl3 (¶8); 170 °C on/off 30% vs >80% continuous (¶8); 2 M repeat unit gives 50% (¶9); PnBuMA, PMMA and green light only in SI tables S18/S19.
Products: only benzyl methacrylate (BzMA) is quantified.
